attributes.action: Protect all applicants qualifying for ILR before Spring 2027 from new ILR rules.
attributes.additional_details: Many Skilled Workers came to the UK under rules offering settlement after five years. Those approaching ILR in early 2027 have built their lives, careers and families around this commitment. Applying new rules retrospectively could force them onto a ten-year route, causing significant financial and emotional hardship. The Government should introduce transitional protections for those completing their five-year qualifying period before Spring 2027, allowing them to apply under the existing rules.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to protect Skilled Workers completing their 5 year ILR qualifying period before Spring 2027 from new settlement rules. They should be allowed to settle under the five year route they entered the UK expecting, without retrospective changes extending their wait to 10 years.

rejection.details:
